desc: L pass: the look-ahead read is not clamped to n (reads SA[n + 1 ..])
old: int ahead = sa[Math.Min(i + SaisPrefetch.Induce, n)]; // the entry
new: int ahead = sa[i + SaisPrefetch.Induce]; // the entry

desc: S pass: the look-ahead read is not clamped to 1 (reads SA[-31 ..])
naming: the look-ahead read is not clamped to m (reads past the sorted LMS positions, past SA[n] for small texts)
old: int ahead = sa[Math.Min(i + SaisPrefetch.Name, m)]; // the sorted LMS position
new: int ahead = sa[i + SaisPrefetch.Name]; // the sorted LMS position

desc: L pass: the prefetch address is the successor position instead of the predecessor (changes no result: a prefetch has no architectural effect)
S pass: no clamp of the prefetch index for empty entries (index -2 is prefetched: no effect)
naming: the name slot is prefetched without the +1 (no effect)
L pass: the look-ahead entry is read from the wrong side (i - distance: an already scanned entry)
old: int ahead = sa[Math.Min(i + SaisPrefetch.Induce, n)]; // the entry
new: int ahead = sa[Math.Max(i - SaisPrefetch.Induce, 0)]; // the entry
